messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Let's check your network status to confirm mobile data is enabled. Please run the following on your phone and share the result:

**check_network_status**

This will show whether mobile data is ON or OFF, along with your signal strength, network type, and other details. Once you provide this, I'll guide you through the next step.

I see from the network status that your mobile data is currently turned off on your phone. Since MMS messaging requires mobile data to be turned on, would you like me to help you enable mobile data? It should not affect your photos or anything else on your phone.

Please explain the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
